name: dependency-license-check
title: Dependency License Check
description: Reads each SPDX expression against your policy (GPL or AGPL in closed source, no or unknown license, source-available terms in a hosted product, deny lists) and catches relicenses between versions with a one-tap "Stay on" the last version under the old license.

meta.stops: GPL dependency shipped in closed source
meta.summary: Reads each new dependency's SPDX license against your policy, so a GPL, unlicensed or relicensed package doesn't slip into your project.
meta.server: Enforce license policy in CI (lockfile scan) so dependencies added outside this UI are caught too.
catches: Copyleft (GPL, AGPL) licenses in closed-source projects
Source-available terms (e.g. BSL, SSPL) in a hosted product
A license change between versions, with an option to stay on the older version
limits: Uses the license metadata you pass; packages sometimes declare a license that differs from their files
Doesn't scan transitive dependencies unless you pass them
Not legal advice: your policy decides what is allowed
a11y: License categories are written in text, not just chip colour
Focus moves to the first fix, or the add button when clear
Package names show the version in a title
